dependency_contract.separate_translation_units_required: Each codec fragment owns private labels/tables; assemble in separate standalone units.

entrypoints.reset_call: RCX points to trusted state; EDX exact state bytes; EAX status
entrypoints.step_call: RCX points to trusted Job96; EAX status

message_limits: No exact message is claimed for CMF method/window, Huffman, symbol/repeat/distance errors, truncation, Adler mismatch or CINFO overdistance.
Dictionary and direct-buffer native method forms remain the existing explicit unsupported domain.
Reasons are decoder branch outputs; there is no fixture ID, input fingerprint, or test-case dispatch.
name: InflaterCodecReason1
reason_lifetime: A failure reason is cached in source-unused state bytes and reproduced on sticky-error calls until a real full reset; status alone does not select a specific message.

0.meaning: No specific reason selected; includes successful calls and unspecified errors

1.branch: RFC1950 header FCHECK modulo-31 validation failed after existing CMF checks

5.branch: RFC1951 stored block LEN/NLEN complement mismatch

service.DFE_message_selection: Reason is passed after actual decoder borrow release, only for DFE error kind.
service.required_source_binding: Producer emits current class/layout/ctor table ifr_errors and IFR_THROWABLE_TYPE from original Source/Code/Frame identities. No Java IDs are stored in the fragment.

state.legacy_comment_Job80: The raw source keeps its original legacy-prefix comment; callers of step_reason must supply Job96.

unchanged_domain: RFC1950/RFC1951 decoding state machine except explicit reason output and source-unused reason cache
